text:
maya: Heads up — I'm planning to merge and apply the TF PR that switches payments-extsecrets to the dedicated service account and shortens rotation TTL to 6h. Need a quick pair to sanity-check SA binding + helm overlay. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/+/1234 :white_check_mark:

devon: can you paste the ExternalSecret snippet? want to check the .spec.template/serviceAccountName

maya: sure — snippet:
```
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payments-credentials
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        secret-sync.redwood.com/owner: payments
    serviceAccountName: payments-extsecrets-sa
  refreshInterval: \"6h\"
  data:
    - secretKey: token
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/payments/token
```

sam: will the refreshInterval change trigger immediate reconcile/recreate? we saw a burst earlier that caused transient 429s.

frank: it triggers refresh attempts, but not recreates the K8s Secret unless remote data changed. still, recommend throttled rollout: patch one staging cluster first. also remember extsecrets controller uses the sa to fetch Vault creds — ensure sa has the right serviceAccountToken projection role.

lina: tf plan looks fine for bindings, but note our module generates a roleBinding with clusterRole 'extsecrets-fetcher' — confirm namespace-scoped vs cluster. right now payments is namespaced, plan shows clusterrolebinding. I left a comment in the PR.

maya: good catch — i changed it to RoleBinding in the module param. updated plan at https://ci.internal/plan/1234

devon: oncall FYI @ops-oncall — if reconcile spikes, please watch vault-proxy and rate limit. can we add temporary quota of 0.5 rps per node?

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] terraform apply started by maya in workspace prod-payments — run id tf-apply-987. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/tf-apply-987

maya: applying now, will monitor. tagging sam/frank for a 15m watch window.

sam: on it. watching logs. if we see >100 errors/min will rollback.

frank: i'll kick off a canary in staging: `kubectl patch deployment payments -n staging -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"extsecrets-rollout":"canary"}}}}}'`

lina: tf state locked. +1 from me once canary stable.

ops-bot: [monitoring] alert suppressed for vault-api-errors for 30m (silenced by ops-oncall)

maya: canary stable at t+7m. secrets refreshed, tokens rotated. no spike in errors.

devon: awesome — go ahead to prod when ready. leave a note in the incident channel if anything odd.

maya: applied in prod. command: `terraform apply -auto-approve` finished. outputs: payments_sa=payments-extsecrets-sa

sam: spot-checked logs and KV access looks normal. :thumbsup:

frank: follow-up todo: add tf var to control refreshInterval per namespace. opened issue #452.

lina: added a short doc snippet to the payments runbook about SA ownership.

maya: thanks all. closing thread.
